templates.text: Efficient offense: keep running the situations that generate the most points
Inefficient offense: look for better shots before chasing more volume
Solid defense: keep up the pressure and the contests on opposing shots
Vulnerable defense: adjust the coverage to limit the opponent's comfortable shots
Positive efficiency margin: protect the rotations that sustain it
Negative efficiency margin: review the rotations that hurt it the most
Shooting advantage: look for volume in the half court
Ineffective shooting: prioritize better-quality shots and attacks on the rim
You score with total efficiency: keep the shot mix and the trips to the line
Low total efficiency: add free throws and avoid low-quality shots
Every field-goal attempt pays off: keep the volume of the highest-value shots
Every field-goal attempt pays little: replace low-value shots with better options
Effective on two-pointers: keep attacking the rim and the paint
Ineffective on two-pointers: improve shot selection near the rim
Reliable from three: create advantages to open up three-point shots
Unreliable from three: limit forced threes and take only the open ones
Good free-throw percentage: draw fouls and close out games from the line
Unreliable free throws: do not depend on the line to close out games
You reach the line often: keep attacking the rim to draw fouls
You rarely reach the line: attack the rim more to draw fouls
You take care of the ball: keep the movement calm and unhurried
You turn the ball over too much: simplify decisions and secure the pass
You dominate the offensive glass: send players to the boards for second chances
Little offensive rebounding: decide how many players to send to the boards per opponent
You finish the defensive rebound well: use it to get out and run
You give up defensive rebounds: reinforce the box-out to deny second chances
Orderly ball movement, more assists than turnovers: keep moving the ball
More turnovers than assists: lower the risk in your passes
A large share of baskets come off passes: keep the ball movement going
Few baskets come off passes: look for more passes before the shot
